tasks.label: resend-verification
args: const fs=require('fs'); const env={}; for (const line of fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) { const m=line.match(/^([^#=]+)=(.*)$/); if (m) env[m[1]] = m[2].trim(); } const { Resend } = require('resend'); const resend = new Resend(env.RESEND_API_KEY); resend.emails.send({ from: env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, to: env.CONTACT_TO_EMAIL, subject: 'Test delivery', replyTo: 'test@example.com', text: 'Hello from verification' }).then((r) => { console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, id: r.id }, null, 2)); }).catch((e) => { console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(e) }, null, 2)); process.exit(1); });
